config.notes: Course pages (www.westernsydney.edu.au/future/study/courses/...): start dates are printed as full dates after "Next Start Date" in the summary panel. The international annual fee sits in the page component data as internationalFees "AUD $..." (the rendered page shows it under "Indicative annual fee"; the domestic "from $" figure is separate and not read). In the stored copy that data is only visible as text on some pages, so many pages give no fee. Duration and campuses are in the summary panel. The pages do not print IELTS: central rule at westernsydney.edu.au/international/studying/entry-requirements is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0, higher for nursing, allied health, medicine, teaching, social work and professional psychology. Handbook pages (handbook.westernsydney.edu.au/2021-2025) are archived editions with no fees or start dates; only study mode, location and AQF level are read from them.
